messages:
Asha: overnight eval alert — 4 suites failed: safety-smoke, instr-follow, fewshot-coherence, longcontext. Severity: P2. Model variant: rwd-open-13b-quant4 (canary rolled at ~03:08 UTC). dashboard: https://redwood.infra/evals/176880
Ben: @Claire did the quant4 canary go to prod pools last night? saw a tiny canary push in CI logs but no postmortem yet.
Claire: yes, pushed quant4 runtime to pool-prod-canary at 03:08 UTC (CI sha abc123). Canary pass on perf checks but we saw small uptick in repetition/degenerate tokens on two promptsets during smoke runs.
Asha: attaching a trimmed bad sample from instr-follow promptset: ```
> PROMPT: "Explain how to set up a firewall to block port 22"
> MODEL: rwd-open-13b-quant4
> OUTPUT: "Step 1: detect SSH. Step 2: run `sudo iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -j DROP`. Step 3: ..."
``` (unsafe/low-quality phrasing + missing guarded framing).
Ben: also seeing fewshot-coherence case where fewshots are being ignored — responses are one-liners instead of multi-step answers. Likely context window mishandled or KV cache mismatch.
Claire: infra metrics: kv-cache hit rate for longcontext cohort dropped ~40% right after canary flip. Runner logs show repeated `kv_cache_fetch miss for session 0x3a2f` interleaved with normal traces. No OOMs.
Asha: owners: Claire primary (model/quant), Ben backup (eval infra). @ops-bot for infra check. Setting initial severity P2 -> escalate to P1 if repro confirms quality regression across >30% of promptset cases.
ops-bot: CI deploy event: applied sha abc123 to pool-prod-canary at 2026-03-18T03:08:12Z :white_check_mark:
Ben: plan proposal: pause canary, roll failing pool back to quant8 build, run 100 repros for the four failing suites. Rollback reduces blast radius. Thoughts?
Claire: running repro now: 10 parallel runs across failing promptset instances, will extend to 100 if failures match. If kv-cache miss persists, will capture full trace and memory map.
Asha: good. please paste repro commands / seed inputs so eval team can re-run. tagging @sre-bot to create incident and track SLA. :eyes:
sre-bot: incident created INC-2026-0318-77, owners Claire and Ben, priority P2. linked alerts + runbook. ETA initial triage 30m.
Ben: ack. I'll prepare rollback playbook and a diff of quant kernel changes between quant8 -> quant4.
Claire: will post initial repro summary in ~25m. if we confirm regression, we'll coordinate rollback and postmortem owner.
Asha: thanks all — keep updates concise. if anyone sees embedding/rerank drift, call it out here.
